ai_review.summary: Average show with solid jams and a long Shakedown Street, but Garcia’s sloppy fingering hurts the overall vibe; recording quality unclear.
ai_review.review: The performance offers some enjoyable jams and an extended Shakedown Street that fans appreciate, yet Jerry Garcia is noted for fat‑fingering many licks, keeping the show from reaching higher heights. No specific comments on the audio source or clarity were provided, leaving the recording quality ambiguous.
